description: Ask Daniels AI Design Studio to set up and manage a business's profile in ChatGPT (OpenAI Business Hub). The request is free and publishes nothing; a person replies with an estimate. Setup and management are paid services. This is a setup service — it does not change or guarantee how often ChatGPT recommends a business. An eligible representative of the business completes any identity verification OpenAI requires directly with OpenAI. Do not send identity documents or ID numbers.

contact_email.description: A working email for someone at the business. Required.

has_brand_record.description: Does the business already have a Brand Discovery Record? Default unknown.

notes.description: Anything else a person should know. Do not include ID numbers.

website.description: The business's website, as a full URL starting with https://

name: request_chatgpt_business_setup
title: Request ChatGPT Business setup
